title: The Lantern Wick Trimmed
youtube_title: The Lantern Wick Trimmed | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude shows up in what you do next.
summary: At a workshop with tools on a low peg, Tala notices that Papa has already taken care of a lantern wick trimmed so your walk would be even. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Tala does one useful thing Papa did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
